meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能帮你把 MRI、EEG 等科研数据整理成符合 BIDS 规范的目录、按条件查询文件、校验是否合规、把 DICOM 转成 BIDS,并编写 JSON 元数据文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can organize neuroscience data like MRI and EEG into BIDS-compliant folders, query files in a BIDS dataset, validate compliance, convert DICOM to BIDS, and write JSON sidecar metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with BIDS datasets like MRI, EEG or MEG — organizing data, querying files, or validating compliance.
